title: Satisfied
alsoKnownAs: All My Life I Had a Longing
description: Satisfied in Tonic Solfa to SATISFIED (HUDSON): the solfa with the words, staff notation, the four verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: Clara Tear Williams wrote the words in 1875 at Ralph E. Hudson’s request, for a book he was preparing; Hudson wrote the tune the same year.
underlay: All my life I had a long-ing For a drink from some clear spring, That I hoped would quench the burn-ing Of the thirst I felt with-in. Hal-le-lu-jah! I have found Him Whom my soul so long has craved! Je-sus sat-is-fies my long-ings, Through His blood I now am saved.

lines: All my life I had a longing
For a drink from some clear spring,
That I hoped would quench the burning
Of the thirst I felt within.

verses.label: Refrain
lines: Hallelujah! I have found Him
Whom my soul so long has craved!
Jesus satisfies my longings,
Through His blood I now am saved.
Feeding on the husks around me,
Till my strength was almost gone,
Longed my soul for something better,
Only still to hunger on.
Poor I was, and sought for riches,
Something that would satisfy,
But the dust I gathered round me
Only mocked my soul’s sad cry.
Well of water, ever springing,
Bread of life so rich and free,
Untold wealth that never faileth,
My Redeemer is to me.
